claim: In June 2026 the West End is running Hamilton (Victoria Palace), The Lion King (Lyceum), Wicked (Apollo Victoria), Les Misérables (Sondheim), Phantom of the Opera (His Majesty's), Mamma Mia! (Novello), Hadestown (Lyric), SIX (Vaudeville), Stranger Things: The First Shadow (Phoenix), Matilda (Cambridge), Book of Mormon (Prince of Wales), Moulin Rouge! (Piccadilly), Cabaret (Kit Kat Club at Playhouse), Harry Potter and the Cursed Child (Palace), Oliver! (Gielgud), Disney's Hercules (Drury Lane) and The Mousetrap (St. Martin's).
quote: The Phantom of the Opera – His Majesty's Theatre; The Lion King – Lyceum Theatre; SIX the Musical – Vaudeville Theatre; Mamma Mia! – Novello Theatre; Hamilton – Victoria Palace Theatre; Wicked – Apollo Victoria Theatre; Les Misérables – Sondheim Theatre; Hadestown – Lyric Theatre

claim: New 2026 West End openings include Sinatra The Musical at the Aldwych from June 2026, Disney's Hercules at Drury Lane, Paddington The Musical at the Savoy, Avenue Q at the Shaftesbury, Beetlejuice at the Prince Edward, and Kinky Boots at the London Coliseum.
quote: Sinatra The Musical will celebrate the life, legacy and iconic songs of Frank Sinatra at the Aldwych Theatre from June 2026.

claim: West End LIVE 2026 takes over Trafalgar Square on Saturday 20 and Sunday 21 June with free performances from more than 50 musicals including Hamilton, Wicked, Les Misérables, The Lion King and Disney's Hercules.
quote: West End LIVE is running in Trafalgar Square in London on Saturday 20 and Sunday 21 June 2026. The event will transform the West End for a weekend of live performances from more than 50 top London musicals.

claim: Shakespeare's Globe summer 2026 season runs A Midsummer Night's Dream (23 April–29 August), Mother Courage and Her Children (7 May–27 June, with Michelle Terry in the title role) and Much Ado About Nothing (11 June–24 October).
quote: A Midsummer Night's Dream runs from 23 April to 29 August... Mother Courage and Her Children runs from 7 May to 27 June... Much Ado About Nothing runs from 11 June to 24 October

claim: Shakespeare's Globe releases £5 Rush standing 'groundling' tickets in the Yard every Friday at 11:00am for the following week's performances, allocated first-come first-served online; £10 standing and seated tickets £25–£65 are otherwise available.
quote: Every Friday at 11.00am, a limited number of £5 standing tickets are released for performances in the following week, available only online and allocated on a first come, first served basis.

claim: The Royal Ballet performs Frederick Ashton's La Fille mal gardée at the Royal Opera House from 30 May to 9 June 2026, with The Marriage of Figaro from The Royal Opera running 4 June to 2 July 2026.
quote: La Fille mal gardée, described as 'a ballet of pure sunshine,' runs from May 30 to June 9, 2026... The Marriage of Figaro runs from June 4 to July 2, 2026

claim: TKTS Leicester Square, run by the not-for-profit Society of London Theatre, sells same-day West End seats at up to 50% off (sometimes 69%) and opens Mon–Sat 10:30am–6pm and Sun 11am–4pm, with new on-the-day inventory online at officiallondontheatre.com/TKTS at 12:01am daily.
quote: New on-the-day tickets become available online at 12:01 AM daily on officiallondontheatre.com/TKTS... Monday–Saturday: 10:30 AM – 6:00 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

claim: TodayTix offers three discount programs for West End tickets — Rush (early-morning same-day releases), Lottery (random draws hours before curtain) and Drops — with persistence and flexibility on show choice the key to winning.
quote: TodayTix is a dedicated app for scoring cheap West End tickets, with three discount programs: Rush, Lottery, and Drops.

claim: Ronnie Scott's Soho jazz club has a packed June 2026 calendar including the Ronnie Scott's Jazz Orchestra (1 June), Macy Gray (4–5 June), six-time Grammy-nominated saxophonist Lakecia Benjamin (17 June) and Nik West (3 June).
quote: Ronnie Scott's has an extensive June 2026 lineup including performances by the Ronnie Scott's Jazz Orchestra (June 1), Sarah Tandy (June 2), Nik West (June 3), Macy Gray (June 4-5)... Lakecia Benjamin (June 17)

claim: Wigmore Hall's 125th-anniversary season includes a Kanneh-Mason family residency culmination in June 2026 (pianists Isata and Jeneba, violinist Braimah, cellist Sheku) and Les Arts Florissants on 1 June 2026 at 7:30pm.
quote: four of the celebrated Kanneh-Mason siblings – pianists Isata and Jeneba, violinist Braimah, and cellist Sheku – come together for a performance marking the culmination of their family residency. Les Arts Florissants will perform on Monday, June 1, 2026 at 7:30pm

claim: Major June 2026 arena gigs include Lily Allen at the O2 Arena on 27 June 2026, with Kraftwerk playing the Royal Albert Hall on 4 June 2026 and Bad Bunny at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on 27–28 June 2026 and Gorillaz' Mountain Tour there on 20 June 2026.
quote: Lily Allen is performing at the O2 Arena on 27th June 2026... Kraftwerk is performing at the Royal Albert Hall on Thursday 04 June 2026... Bad Bunny is scheduled for Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on 27th & 28th Jun 2026, and Gorillaz The Mountain Tour is at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on 20th Jun 2026
